title: Rameswaram Tour Packages from Chennai: 2 & 3 Day Temple & Coastal Trips
excerpt: Book peaceful Rameswaram tour packages from Chennai with SR Tours & Travels. Visit Sri Ramanathaswamy Temple, 22 Holy Theerthams, Agni Theertham, Pamban Bridge, Dhanushkodi, Madurai & Thiruchendur.
description: Affordable Rameswaram tour packages from Chennai by SR Tours & Travels. 2-day & 3-day Rameswaram, Dhanushkodi, Madurai & Thiruchendur temple tours in AC cabs & tempo travellers. Call +91 9884300373.
html:
Embark on a sacred coastal pilgrimage with our customized Rameswaram tour packages from Chennai. At SR Tours & Travels, we arrange comfortable AC cars, Innova Crysta SUVs, and group Tempo Travellers for families, elders, and devotees visiting one of India's holiest Char Dham shrines.

Highlights Covered in Our Rameswaram Tour Packages

  • Sri Ramanathaswamy Temple & 22 Holy Theerthams: Darshan at the iconic Jyotirlinga temple and the world's longest pillared corridor.
  • Agni Theertham & Panchmukhi Hanuman Temple: Sacred sea bath and floating stones shrine.
  • Dhanushkodi & Ram Setu (Arichal Munai): Scenic drive to the tip where the Bay of Bengal meets the Indian Ocean.
  • Pamban Bridge & APJ Abdul Kalam Memorial: Iconic sea bridge views and the Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam National Memorial.

Popular Rameswaram Itineraries from Chennai

  • 2 Days / 1 Night Rameswaram Express Tour: Chennai → Pamban Bridge → Ramanathaswamy Temple → Dhanushkodi → Kalam Memorial → Return to Chennai.
  • 3 Days / 2 Nights Madurai – Rameswaram – Thiruchendur Temple Tour: Combine Madurai Meenakshi Amman Temple, Rameswaram Jyotirlinga, and Thiruchendur Murugan Temple in one seamless trip.
  • 4 Days Rameswaram – Kanyakumari – Madurai South India Tour: Complete spiritual & coastal circuit. See also our South India Temple Tour.

Transparent Pricing & Comfortable Fleet

Available in AC Swift Dzire / Etios, Toyota Innova / Crysta, and 12–18 Seater Tempo Travellers with experienced highway drivers. View our Tariff or contact us at +91 9884300373 / 9884050506 to book your Rameswaram tour package today.
